summary_md: **ergophobian ([@indefatigabile](https://x.com/indefatigabile/status/2116060732353863810))** presents **comfyfield** (MIT), pitched as an open Higgsfield alternative: you choose a format that has already gone viral, drop your product into it, sign off on an inexpensive preview frame and only then spend on the full ComfyUI render; agents can drive the same flow over MCP, using your own Comfy key ([ergophobian/comfyfield](https://github.com/ergophobian/comfyfield)).
